mapper.select: SELECT DASH_KEY AS dashKey, DASH_NAME AS dashName, DASH_TYPE AS dashType, DASH_MULTI_X AS dashMultiLeft, DASH_MULTI_Y AS dashMultiRight, DASH_CHART AS dashChart, DASH_CHART_X AS dashChartX, DASH_CHART_Y AS dashChartY, DASH_ICON AS dashIcon, DASH_COLOR AS dashColor, DASH_HTML AS html, DASH_CONDITION AS dashCondition, DASH_COMMENT AS dashComment, USEYN AS useYn FROM UI_CUSTOM_DASHBOARD_DEFAULT
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO UI_CUSTOM_DASHBOARD_POSITION(MENU_KEY, DASH_KEY, DASH_ID, DASH_X, DASH_Y, DASH_WIDTH, DASH_HEIGHT, DASH_MIN_WIDTH, DASH_MIN_HEIGHT, DASH_MAX_WIDTH, DASH_MAX_HEIGHT) SELECT (SELECT MENU_KEY FROM UI_CUSTOM_DASHBOARD_MENU WHERE ADMIN_ID = #{adminId} AND DEFAULT_MENU = 'Y'), @r := @r + 1, CONCAT((SELECT MENU_KEY FROM UI_CUSTOM_DASHBOARD_MENU WHERE ADMIN_ID = #{adminId} AND DEFAULT_MENU = 'Y'),'_', @r), DASH_X, DASH_Y, DASH_WIDTH, DASH_HEIGHT, DASH_MIN_WIDTH, DASH_MIN_HEIGHT, DASH_MAX_WIDTH, DASH_MAX_HEIGHT FROM UI_CUSTOM_DASHBOARD_POSITION_DEFAULT a, (SELECT @r := IFNULL(MIN(DASH_KEY), 0)-1 FROM UI_CUSTOM_DASHBOARD WHERE ADMIN_ID = #{adminId}) r ORDER BY POSITION_SEQ

mapper.select: SELECT A.MENU_KEY AS menuKey, A.DASH_ID AS id, A.DASH_X AS x, A.DASH_Y AS y, A.DASH_WIDTH AS width, A.DASH_HEIGHT AS height, A.DASH_MIN_WIDTH AS minWidth, A.DASH_MIN_HEIGHT AS minHeight, A.DASH_MAX_WIDTH AS maxWidth, A.DASH_MAX_HEIGHT AS maxHeight, B.DASH_KEY AS dashKey, B.DASH_NAME AS dashName, B.DASH_TYPE AS dashType, B.DASH_MULTI_X AS dashMultiLeft, B.DASH_MULTI_Y AS dashMultiRight, B.DASH_CHART AS dashChart, B.DASH_CHART_X AS dashChartX, B.DASH_CHART_Y AS dashChartY, B.DASH_ICON AS dashIcon, B.DASH_COLOR AS dashColor, B.DASH_HTML AS html, B.DASH_CONDITION AS dashCondition, B.DASH_COMMENT AS dashComment, B.ADMIN_ID AS adminId, B.USEYN AS useYn FROM UI_CUSTOM_DASHBOARD_POSITION A LEFT JOIN UI_CUSTOM_DASHBOARD B ON A.DASH_KEY = B.DASH_KEY WHERE A.MENU_KEY = #{menuKey} AND B.ADMIN_ID = #{adminId}
mapper.insert: REPLACE INTO UI_CUSTOM_DASHBOARD_POSITION (MENU_KEY, DASH_KEY, DASH_ID, DASH_X, DASH_Y, DASH_WIDTH, DASH_HEIGHT, DASH_MIN_WIDTH, DASH_MIN_HEIGHT, DASH_MAX_WIDTH, DASH_MAX_HEIGHT) VALUES ( ${menuKey}, ${dashKey}, #{id}, ${x}, ${y}, ${width}, ${height}, ${minWidth}, ${minHeight}, ${maxWidth}, ${maxHeight})
mapper.select: SELECT DT AS date, IFNULL(REMAINING, 0) AS remaining, IFNULL(USED, 0) AS used, IFNULL(TOTAL, 0) AS total, IFNULL(USED_PERCENT, 0) AS usedP FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DT, '%Y-%m-%d' ) AS DT FROM ( SELECT DATE_ADD(NOW(),INTERVAL -1 DAY) AS DT UNION SELECT DATE_ADD(NOW(),INTERVAL -2 DAY) UNION SELECT DATE_ADD(NOW(),INTERVAL -3 DAY) UNION SELECT DATE_ADD(NOW(),INTERVAL -4 DAY) UNION SELECT DATE_ADD(NOW(),INTERVAL -5 DAY) UNION SELECT DATE_ADD(NOW(),INTERVAL -6 DAY) UNION SELECT DATE_ADD(NOW(),INTERVAL -7 DAY) ) AS X ) AS A LEFT JOIN UI_HDFS_SIZE B ON (A.DT = DATE_FORMAT(B.`DATE`, '%Y-%m-%d' )) ORDER BY DT
